ProtoCraft — circuit automation

Usage:
  protocraft-cli templates
  protocraft-cli new --output project.protocraft [--template 555-led-1hz] [--name 'My circuit'] [--open]
  protocraft-cli open <project.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli devices [--filter term] [--limit N] [--offset N]
  protocraft-cli device <model>
  protocraft-cli device-project <model> --output project.protocraft
  protocraft-cli pcb-check <project>
  protocraft-cli pcb-route <project> --output routed.protocraft [--grid-mm 0.25] [--track-width-mm 0.25] [--max-expansions 600000] [--no-optimize]
  protocraft-cli pcb-info <project>
  protocraft-cli pcb-export <project> --format kicad|svg --output file
  protocraft-cli pcb-manufacture <project> --preset jlcpcb|standard --output new-folder --kicad path/kicad-cli.exe
  protocraft-cli engines
  protocraft-cli components
  protocraft-cli examples <folder>
  protocraft-cli import-proteus <file.pdsprj|file.dsn> --output <file.protocraft> [--report <report.json>]
  protocraft-cli info <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli commands [--filter <term>]
  protocraft-cli run <file.protocraft> (--actions <actions.json> | --cmd <id> --params '<json>' [...]) [--output <new.protocraft>]
  protocraft-cli validate <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli netlist <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli simulate <file.protocraft> [--engine stable|dynamic|mixed] [--transient step_s end_s] [--csv file.csv]
  protocraft-cli spice <file.protocraft> [--transient step_s end_s] [--output file.cir]

new creates a project; --open starts the desktop editor if it is installed beside the CLI.
run applies all commands as one atomic Engine edit; use --output to save the result.
info, commands, and run write JSON to stdout. Points use integer grid coordinates.
Proteus import is experimental: review the warnings and limitations report.
Native simulation is written in Rust: stable, dynamic, and mixed solvers; DC and transient analyses; generic models.
Use engines and components to inspect available options. C/L start at zero; digital states can be configured with the Mixed solver.
